details: Bitcoin traded around $78,000, achieving approximately a 25% gain in August, marking its strongest August performance since 2017. This resilience is notable despite rising oil prices and increased expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. The cryptocurrency also saw significant inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs, further demonstrating its strength against macroeconomic pressures.
title: Bitcoin Defies Macro Headwinds with Best August Since 2017

details: Robinhood Chain's decentralized exchange (DEX) recorded a new all-time high of $989 million in single-day trading volume during August. The total value locked (TVL) on the chain also reached a record $708 million, nearly doubling month-over-month, as utility tokens gained considerable traction over memecoins.
title: Robinhood Chain Hits Record $989M Daily DEX Volume

details: Bitwise's Solana staking Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF), trading under the ticker BSOL, has surpassed $1 billion in assets under management. This milestone was achieved just 10 months after its launch, positioning Solana as one of only three cryptocurrencies with a billion-dollar ETF product, despite a challenging bear market.
title: Bitwise Solana ETF Crosses $1 Billion AUM in 10 Months

details: Michael Saylor's MicroStrategy has once again expanded its Bitcoin treasury, acquiring an additional 4,603 BTC for $369.7 million at an average price of $80,318 per coin. This latest purchase increases the company's total holdings to 845,050 BTC, reinforcing its status as the largest publicly traded corporate holder of Bitcoin.
title: MicroStrategy Buys $370M Bitcoin, Total Holdings Over 845,000 BTC

details: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, has announced a partnership with the London Stock Exchange (LSE) to tokenize the 100 largest LSE-listed companies. These 1:1-backed "xStocks" are expected to be available to investors in over 110 countries, with plans for trading on LSE 24, the exchange's extended-hours venue, pending regulatory approval.
title: Kraken Parent Payward to Tokenize 100 London-Listed Stocks

details: A Balancer V1-style liquidity pool was exploited for approximately $234,000 due to a rounding-error bug, according to blockchain security firm Slowmist. This vulnerability is similar to a flaw that resulted in a $116 million hack of Balancer's V2 pools in November 2025. Balancer Labs previously ceased operations as a company in March 2026.
title: Balancer V1 Pool Hacked for $234K Due to Rounding Error

details: Russia's new digital asset law came into effect on September 1st, legalizing regulated cryptocurrency trading nationwide. However, the law imposes a yearly cap of approximately $3,700 for retail investors through licensed intermediaries. The Bank of Russia will be responsible for overseeing the regulated market and determining which digital assets are permissible.
title: Russia's New Crypto Law Caps Retail Investments at $3,700

details: Vietnam is launching a national pilot framework to regulate crypto assets, with a strong focus on real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. This initiative aims to attract foreign investment and stimulate economic growth. Industry experts estimate that the global tokenized RWA market could exceed $14 trillion by 2030, positioning Vietnam for significant upside.
title: Vietnam Embraces Crypto with $14T Tokenization Initiative

details: Tom Lee, chairman of BitMine Immersion Technologies, has made a bold prediction that Ethereum could reach $6,000. This forecast is contingent on Bitcoin climbing to $150,000 and the ETH/BTC ratio rising to 0.04. Lee believes that the CLARITY Act, if passed, will "supercharge" Wall Street demand for Ethereum.
title: Tom Lee Predicts Ethereum to Hit $6,000 Amid CLARITY Act

details: BitMine Immersion Technologies has further increased its Ethereum holdings, acquiring another 53,501 ETH, bringing its total to 5.90 million ETH. This places the company close to controlling 5% of Ethereum's circulating supply and marks its 65th consecutive week of ETH acquisitions, indicating a consistent long-term strategy.
title: BitMine Accumulates 5.9M ETH, Nears 5% of Total Supply

details: Binance has expanded its product offerings to include options on 1,000 US stocks and ETFs. This strategic move coincides with Binance's monthly Traditional Finance (TradFi) perpetual volume reaching $433 billion, highlighting a growing convergence and increasing liquidity between traditional financial markets and the crypto ecosystem.
title: Binance Adds Options on 1,000 US Stocks and ETFs

details: Ark Invest, led by Cathie Wood, has acquired $37 million worth of shares in Block Inc., the company founded and led by Jack Dorsey. This investment signals continued institutional interest and confidence in companies operating at the intersection of traditional finance and the evolving cryptocurrency landscape.
title: Ark Invest Buys $37 Million in Jack Dorsey's Block Inc. Shares
